title: Five Minutes, One Prompt
_designNote: Violet and teal — a builder's palette, distinct from sai_ai_interviewer's green/red investigation and sai_stage_fright's amber/blue warmth. Three videos, three looks, no batch-sameness.
_voiceNote: pace 1.15 and temperature 0.95, a deliberate change from the earlier variations. This is a build-in-public demo, not an argument that needs room to land — brisk suits it, and higher temperature gives the emphasis some lift instead of a recital. Still well under the 1.25 that measured ~200 wpm and read as an advert.
_musicNote: Track chosen by measurement, not by ear: at matched loudness 'Killing Time' puts 11 dB less energy in the 300-3400 Hz speech band than every other bright/driving candidate, and its 45-91s window has the flattest loudness range in the shortlist (LRA 2.0). Bright and grooving at 100 bpm, so it carries momentum without arguing with the VO. bedLufs -30 per the new default — the previous cut's bed was too present.
_sfxNote: A cue lands on frame 1 — the promise rule says three seconds of silence reads as a video that has not started. The rest are derived: riser into the retention beat, a hit on the held beat, a ping on the turn, whoosh into the end card.
_note: `say` is the spoken text and the alignment key — it must match AVATAR_SCRIPT.md word for word. Beat start/end are NOT authored here; bin/align.mjs derives them from whisper word timestamps.
_hookNote: Promise rule (VARIATION_AXES.md): the first three seconds state what was built AND owe the viewer the prompt. Cover everything after 3s and a debt remains — that is the test.

beats.say: I built this scrolling site in five minutes. Here's the prompt.
beats.caption: 5 MINUTES. ONE PROMPT.

stock.query: designer scrolling website animation screen closeup

beats.say: Animated sections, scroll triggers, hover states. No template.
beats.caption: NO TEMPLATE

stock.query: colorful website landing page design bright screen

beats.say: One tool. Claude Opus five, in the terminal.
beats.caption: OPUS 5, IN THE TERMINAL

stock.query: code editor screen colorful syntax highlighting bright

beats.say: Step one. Describe the feeling, not the layout.
beats.caption: FEELING, NOT LAYOUT

beats.say: Say cinematic. Say editorial. It picks the type and the spacing.
beats.caption: "CINEMATIC" · "EDITORIAL"

beats.say: Step two. Name the scroll behaviour out loud.
beats.caption: NAME THE SCROLL

stock.query: smooth scrolling web page motion closeup

beats.say: Sections that fade up. A header that shrinks.
beats.caption: FADE UP · SHRINK

stock.query: clean white minimal web page scrolling bright

beats.say: Step three, and this is the one people skip.
beats.caption: THE STEP PEOPLE SKIP

stock.query: developer looking at laptop screen thinking night

beats._music: Retention beat — the open loop from the hook starts paying off here. Riser peaks on the cut, hit resolves into it.

beats.say: Ask it to open the page and look at it.
beats.caption: ASK IT TO LOOK
beats._music: The line the whole video exists for. Bed out, hit on the cut, nothing under it.

beats.say: It opens a browser, sees what's broken, and fixes it.
beats.caption: IT SEES WHAT'S BROKEN

stock.query: web browser window loading interface screen

beats._music: The turn — this is the payoff the hook promised.

beats.say: You are not writing code. You are giving notes.
beats.caption: YOU'RE GIVING NOTES

beats.say: It will not guess your brand colours.
beats.caption: IT WON'T GUESS

beats.say: Paste the palette. Two lines. Done.
beats.caption: PASTE THE PALETTE

stock.query: hands typing keyboard fast closeup dark

beats.say: Five minutes to a first version you can react to.
beats.caption: SOMETHING TO REACT TO

graphic.line: Describe it. Run it. Give notes.
graphic.sub: the whole loop, in five minutes

_stockNote: Queries for `what`, `tool` and `why2` were reselected after measuring mean frame luma: the originals rendered at 6-21 out of 255, i.e. effectively black frames carrying only a caption. A video about visible animated websites cannot have its brightest claim land on an empty frame.
